newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises slightly.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises slightly.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 24.3 points or 0.83 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index rose 0.90 percent.
Nov 8 Nov 1 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
Overall, the Explorers index was little changed at the close of business last week but there was some strong turnover in selected stocks, Eyres Reed analyst Martin Angel said.
Commodity prices did nothing to help with the price of bullion still flat around US$378.80 an ounce, he said.
Money Mining NL edged 3.0 cents higher to 22.5 cents, Arboyne NL put on 6.0 cents to 29 cents and Sipa Resources International NL gained 7.0 cents to 55 cents.
On the downside, Majestic Resources NL lost 5.0 cents to 25 cents, Diamin Resources NL lost 1.0 cent to 4.3 cents.
The resource sector still needs another major discovery or a strong turnaround in commodity prices, Angel said.
